description: This file implements a frontend React component for handling the OAuth sign-in callback from an external provider via Supabase. It processes URL parameters, exchanges authorization code for a session, manages loading and error states, and redirects accordingly.

methods.name: CallbackInner
methods.description: React component that handles the OAuth callback logic, including exchanging code for session and managing UI states.

methods.name: AuthCallbackPage
methods.description: Main component rendering the Suspense fallback UI and embedding the CallbackInner component.
